design_detail: 2% on net wealth above ISK 200m, rising to 9% for couples above ISK 10bn (as reported)
quote_original: Flokkurinn vill á móti taka upp auðlegðarskatt, tvö prósent á hreina eign umfram 200 milljónir króna
quote_en: The party in turn wants to introduce a wealth tax, two percent on net assets above 200 million krónur
source_title: Sósíalistar segjast ætla að útrýma fátækt á næsta ári og boða fordæmalitla útgjaldaaukningu
grading_note: Party manifesto for the 2021 Alþingi election as reported by Heimildin, with rate and threshold (A).

design_detail: auðlegðarskattur in the chapter "Skattleggjum hin ríku"
quote_original: Þar segir að endurreisn skattheimtu á hin ríku snúist um að leggja á auðlegðarskatt
quote_en: It says that restoring taxation of the rich means imposing a wealth tax
source_title: Yfirgnæfandi meirihluti vill hækka skatta á hin ríku
grading_note: The party's own news item describing its 2021 election offer; names the tax without specifics (B).

design_detail: moderate wealth tax on individuals' assets, excluding housing
quote_original: Innleiða skal hóflegan auðlegðarskatt á eignir einstaklinga, að undanskildu íbúðarhúsnæði
quote_en: A moderate wealth tax on individuals' assets, excluding residential housing, is to be introduced
source_title: Efnahagsmál (stefna, Landsfundur 2023)
grading_note: Policy adopted at the 2023 national congress; names the tax, no rate or threshold (B).

design_detail: "skynsamlega útfærður stóreignaskattur", more than ISK 20bn a year
quote_original: Skynsamlega útfærður stóreignaskattur gæti aukið tekjur ríkisins um yfir 20 milljarða
quote_en: A sensibly designed large-estates (wealth) tax could raise state revenue by over ISK 20 billion
source_title: Skattar og ójöfnuður: Réttlátara og skilvirkara skattkerfi
grading_note: ASÍ's own tax report; it says repeal of the auðlegðarskattur raised inequality and recommends a large-estates tax in its summary. Phrased as what a tax 'could' raise (B).

design_detail: Amendment to extend the auðlegðarskattur in the 2014 revenue bill, with an ISK 30m/40m exemption for own housing; ISK 8-9bn a year
quote_original: Hér leggjum við til framlengingu svonefnds auðlegðarskatts
quote_en: Here we propose extending the so-called wealth tax
source_title: Tekjuaðgerðir fjárlagafrumvarps 2014, 2. mál, 143. löggjafarþing, 42. fundur
grading_note: Speaking for the Left-Green minority amendment to keep the tax after 2014; says abandoning it is utterly absurd. Moving a proposal in his own speech (A).

design_detail: 1.5% on net wealth exceeding ISK 200m for the richest 1%
quote_original: auka lítillega skattbyrði allra ríkasta fólksins með stóreignaskatti á hreina eign umfram 200 milljónir króna
quote_en: slightly increase the tax burden on the very richest people with a wealth tax on net assets exceeding 200 million krónur
source_title: Sanngjarn og lögmætur stóreignaskattur
grading_note: Samfylkingin 2021 election policy published by candidate Brynja Liv Bragadóttir specifying a wealth tax on net assets exceeding ISK 200m (A).

design_detail: Tekjutengdur auðlegðarskattur: 3 milljarðar kr (income-linked wealth tax raising ISK 3bn)
quote_original: Tekjutengdur auðlegðarskattur: 3 milljarðar kr
quote_en: Income-linked wealth tax: 3 billion krónur
source_title: Fjárfestum í framtíðinni og verjum velferðina
grading_note: Party parliamentary economic policy proposing an income-linked wealth tax to raise 3 billion ISK (B).

design_detail: 1.5% on net wealth exceeding ISK 200m
quote_original: Þessir þrír liðir, eignaskatturinn, hækkun veiðigjalda á stærstu útgerðirnar og aukið skattaeftirlit teljum við að muni skila okkur þeim tekjum
quote_en: These three items, the wealth tax, increase in fishing fees on the largest fishing companies, and increased tax enforcement, we believe will provide us with those revenues
source_title: Sjálfstæðismenn séu að reyna að forðast umræðu um skatta
grading_note: Lead candidate and economist defending Samfylkingin's 1.5% net wealth tax above ISK 200m and naming it as a core funding source (A).

design_detail: innleiddur verði stóreignaskattur með sanngjörnu fríeignamarki
quote_original: innleiddur verði stóreignaskattur með sanngjörnu fríeignamarki
quote_en: a large-estates (wealth) tax should be introduced with a fair exemption threshold
source_title: Stefnumót með frambjóðanda - Jóhann Páll Jóhannsson
grading_note: Candidate platform for Alþingi calling for a wealth tax with a fair exemption threshold (B).

design_detail: stóreignaskattur á umtalsverðar eignir
quote_original: Fleiri skattþrep, hærri persónuafsláttur, þrepaskiptur fjármagnstekjuskattur og stóreignaskattur á umtalsverðar eignir, slá á ójöfnuð
quote_en: More tax brackets, higher personal tax credit, graduated capital gains tax, and a wealth tax on substantial assets, reduce inequality
source_title: Oddný í eldhúsdagsumræðum Alþingis
grading_note: Speech in Alþingi general political debate advocating a wealth tax on substantial assets to reduce inequality (B).

design_detail: auðlegðarskattur verði lagður á stóreignafólk
quote_original: Þar er kallað eftir því að auðlegðarskattur verði lagður á stóreignafólk og að fjármagnstekjuskattur verði hækkaður
quote_en: There it is called for a wealth tax to be levied on large-estate owners and for the capital gains tax to be increased
source_title: Formannaráð vill aukið fé til almannaþjónustunnar
grading_note: Formal resolution of the leadership council (formannaráð) calling for a wealth tax on large-estate owners to fund public services (B).

design_detail: 1 - 1.5% wealth tax on assets exceeding an exemption threshold for ordinary housing, summer houses, and cars
quote_original: Lagður verði á sérstakur eignarskattur á stóreignir (auðlegðarskattur). Gjaldstofninn verði verðmæti eigna umfram fríeignamark
quote_en: A special property tax on large estates (wealth tax) should be imposed. The tax base would be the value of assets exceeding an exemption threshold
source_title: Sanngjörn dreifing skattbyrðar: Hvernig leiðrétta má stóru skattatilfærsluna án þess að veikja velferðarkerfið
grading_note: Union tax policy report proposing a moderate annual wealth tax of 1-1.5% on large estates above primary residence/car thresholds (A).

design_detail: 1 - 1.5% wealth tax on assets exceeding an exemption threshold for ordinary housing, summer houses, and cars
quote_original: Lagður verði á sérstakur eignarskattur á stóreignir (auðlegðarskattur). Gjaldstofninn verði verðmæti eigna umfram fríeignamark
quote_en: A special property tax on large estates (wealth tax) should be imposed. The tax base would be the value of assets exceeding an exemption threshold
source_title: Sanngjörn dreifing skattbyrðar: Hvernig leiðrétta má stóru skattatilfærsluna án þess að veikja velferðarkerfið
grading_note: Co-author of Efling tax policy report recommending an annual wealth tax of 1-1.5% with specified exemptions (A).

design_detail: 1 - 1.5% wealth tax on assets exceeding an exemption threshold for ordinary housing, summer houses, and cars
quote_original: Lagður verði á sérstakur eignarskattur á stóreignir (auðlegðarskattur). Gjaldstofninn verði verðmæti eigna umfram fríeignamark
quote_en: A special property tax on large estates (wealth tax) should be imposed. The tax base would be the value of assets exceeding an exemption threshold
source_title: Sanngjörn dreifing skattbyrðar: Hvernig leiðrétta má stóru skattatilfærsluna án þess að veikja velferðarkerfið
grading_note: Co-author of Efling tax policy report recommending an annual wealth tax of 1-1.5% with specified exemptions (A).

design_detail: auðlegðarskattur á breiðan eignastofn með háu fríeignamarki
quote_original: auðlegðarskattur á breiðan eignastofn með háu fríeignammarki
quote_en: wealth tax on a broad asset base with a high exemption threshold
source_title: Um hvað á að kjósa?
grading_note: Personal blog essay proposing a wealth tax on a broad asset base with high threshold among measures to curb wealth concentration (B).

design_detail: auðlegðarskatt með háu gólfi (wealth tax with high threshold)
quote_original: leggja aftur á eignaskatta (eða auðlegðarskatt með háu gólfi)
quote_en: reintroduce property taxes (or a wealth tax with a high threshold)
source_title: Eðlilegt að hækka skatta þau ríkustu
grading_note: Socialist Party founder advocating reinstating a wealth tax with a high floor in response to crisis (B).

design_detail: 2% on net wealth over ISK 200m for couples, rising to 9% over ISK 10bn
quote_original: svonefndan auðlegðarskatt ... þetta yrði tvö prósent á hreina eign umfram 200 milljónir króna hjá hjónum og upp í níu prósent hjá hjónum sem eiga meira en 10 milljarða
quote_en: this would be two percent on net wealth in excess of 200 million krónur for couples and up to nine percent for couples who own more than 10 billion
source_title: Sanna Magdalena: Leggjum níu prósenta auðlegðarskatt á ríkasta fólkið
grading_note: Reykjavík City Councillor and lead Socialist candidate specifying stepped wealth tax rates from 2% above ISK 200m to 9% above ISK 10bn (A).

design_detail: Stóreignaskattur on very substantial wealth, primary residence excluded
quote_original: „Við höfum talað fyrir stóreignaskatti þar sem heimilið væri undanskilið. Við erum að horfa til þeirra sem eiga mjög mikil auðæfi. Það er alltaf meiri og meiri auður að safnast á færri hendur.“
quote_en: We have called for a wealth tax where the home would be exempt. We are looking to those who possess very substantial wealth. More and more wealth is concentrating in fewer hands.
source_title: Vilja setja hátekjuskatt á laun yfir 1,5 milljónir - Vísir
grading_note: Clear call for stóreignaskattur excluding the family home targeting high wealth; specific rates discussed in party manifesto (B).

design_detail: Reintroduction of auðlegðarskattur on net wealth alongside resource charges
quote_original: styrkja tekjuöflunar- og jöfnunarhlutverk skattkerfisins ... Í því miði telur ASÍ að stjórnvöld eigi að horfa m.a. til ... auðlegðarskatti og sanngjörnu afgjaldi fyrir auðlindanýtingu.
quote_en: strengthen the revenue-generating and equalizing role of the tax system ... To that end, ASÍ believes that the authorities should look, among other things, to ... a wealth tax and a fair charge for resource utilization.
source_title: Skýrsla forseta um störf ASÍ 2021
grading_note: Official ASÍ presidential report and policy submission calling for reintroducing auðlegðarskattur (B).

design_detail: Auðlegðarskattur on broad asset base including overseas company equity
quote_original: ég borgaði auðlegðarskatt ... meðan hann var og hét (og sem ég er almennt fylgjandi)
quote_en: I paid wealth tax ... while it was in effect (and which I am generally in favour of)
source_title: Vilhjálmur Þorsteinsson hættir sem gjaldkeri Samfylkingarinnar - Kjarninn
grading_note: Prominent tech investor/businessperson publicly confirming payment and declaring support for the wealth tax (B).
